tagline: You can now refresh a pipeline managed materialized view or streaming table even when the pipeline owner or run as identity is subject to an attribute based access control (ABAC) policy.
what_it_does: You can now refresh a pipeline managed materialized view or streaming table even when the pipeline owner or run as identity is subject to an attribute based access control (ABAC) policy. Previously, refreshing a materialized view or streaming table managed by a pipeline required the pipeline owner or run as identity to be exempt from any applicable ABAC policy. That limitation has been removed.
why_it_matters: Governed tags requirement ABAC policies use governed tags, not ungoverned tags.
